16	package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest;
17	
18	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
19	
20	/**
21	 * Builds an owner's customer code, formatted {@code '<LAST3>-<NNNN>'} where
22	 * {@code LAST3} is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and
23	 * {@code NNNN} is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than
24	 * the current number of owners, e.g. {@code 'SMI-0007'}.
25	 */
26	@Component
27	public class CustomerCodeGenerator {
28	
29	    /**
30	     * Generate a customer code for a new owner.
31	     *
32	     * @param lastName   the owner's last name; its first three letters (upper-cased) form the prefix
33	     * @param ownerCount the current number of owners; the sequence is one more than this value
34	     * @return the formatted customer code
35	     */
36	    public String generate(String lastName, long ownerCount) {
37	        String prefix = lastName.substring(0, Math.min(3, lastName.length())).toUpperCase();
38	        return String.format("%s-%04d", prefix, ownerCount + 1);
39	    }
40	}

20	import org.springframework.context.annotation.Profile;

26	import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner;

29	/**
30	 * Spring Data JPA specialization of the {@link OwnerRepository} interface
31	 *
32	 * @author Michael Isvy
33	 * @since 15.1.2013
34	 */
35	
36	@Profile("spring-data-jpa")
37	public interface SpringDataOwnerRepository extends OwnerRepository, Repository<Owner, Integer> {
38	
39	    @Override
40	    @Query("SELECT DISTINCT owner FROM Owner owner left join fetch owner.pets WHERE owner.lastName LIKE :lastName%")
41	    Collection<Owner> findByLastName(@Param("lastName") String lastName);
42	
43	    @Override
44	    @Query(
45	        value = "SELECT owner FROM Owner owner WHERE owner.lastName LIKE CONCAT(:lastName, '%')",
46	        countQuery = "SELECT COUNT(owner) FROM Owner owner WHERE owner.lastName LIKE CONCAT(:lastName, '%')")
47	    Page<Owner> findByLastName(@Param("lastName") String lastName, Pageable pageable);
48	
49	    @Override
50	    @Query(
51	        value = "SELECT owner FROM Owner owner",
52	        countQuery = "SELECT COUNT(owner) FROM Owner owner")
53	    Page<Owner> findAll(Pageable pageable);
54	
55	    @Override
56	    @Query("SELECT owner FROM Owner owner left join fetch owner.pets WHERE owner.id =:id")
57	    Owner findById(@Param("id") int id);
58	
59	    @Override
60	    @Query("SELECT owner FROM Owner owner WHERE owner.telephone = :telephone")
61	    Collection<Owner> findByTelephone(@Param("telephone") String telephone);
62	
63	    @Override
64	    @Query("SELECT owner FROM Owner owner WHERE LOWER(owner.lastName) = LOWER(:lastName)")
65	    Collection<Owner> findByLastNameIgnoreCase(@Param("lastName") String lastName);
66	
67	    @Override
68	    @Query("SELECT COUNT(owner) FROM Owner owner")
69	    long count();
70	}

Done. The build compiles cleanly across all three repository profiles and the test suite is green (`Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` → `BUILD SUCCESS`).

## What I changed

The new `customerCode` format is `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`, with the sequence scoped per-city (one more than the owners already in that city). I kept each piece of logic in its natural home rather than bolting it onto one class:

- **`CustomerCodeGenerator`** — new signature `generate(city, lastName, cityOwnerCount)` producing `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`. Factored the "upper-cased first three letters" rule into a private `prefix(...)` helper so it isn't duplicated for city and last name.
- **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — now passes the owner's city and a per-city count instead of the global owner count.
- **`ClinicService` / `ClinicServiceImpl`** — added `countOwnersByCity(String city)`, delegating to the repository (mirroring the existing `countOwners`).
- **`OwnerRepository`** + all three profile implementations (`SpringDataOwnerRepository`, `JpaOwnerRepositoryImpl`, `JdbcOwnerRepositoryImpl`) — added `countByCity(String city)`, using a case-insensitive match consistent with the existing `findByLastNameIgnoreCase` queries.

## Values derived from `customerCode`

The membership number in `OwnerMapper.formatMembershipNumber` builds `"%s-M%02d"` directly from `getCustomerCode()`, so it automatically rebuilds on the new format (e.g. `LON-SMI-0001-M26`) with no change needed. That's the only derived value in the codebase — I grepped `getCustomerCode`/`customerCode` to confirm.

The acceptance test asserting `customerCode` matches `[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}` passes.
